item.title: ELP - Engineering Budget Planning in the AI Era
Engineering Leadership Playbook (ELP)
item.description: Over the last two decades, I have had the privilege of working across software development, consulting, architecture, product engineering, IoT, XR, AI, web3, metaverse, embedded systems, and enterprise modernization. During this journey, I have worked with small incubator team of a few engineers, or enterprise projects with 100s of engineers, consulting organizations, product companies, and engineering teams spread across multiple countries. One observation has remained remarkably consistent. Organizations rarely struggle because of technology.

item.title: AI-Assisted Jagjeevan Dose — My ICU Time!
item.description: We often hear that times are changing. In the AI era, change is no longer gradual — it is accelerated. Today, AI agents assist us in writing, thinking, researching, and even making personal decisions. Many of us now do something unimaginable a few years ago: We even confirm what our doctors say… with AI. AI explains reports. AI answers late-night doubts. AI reassures us when anxiety grows. It is that second opinion!

item.title: AI Integrated Development Environment - 1
item.description: Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) have played a crucial role in shaping the way software is developed. Engineering Practices such as Agile development, eXtreme Programming, Test-Driven Development (TDD), became practical largely because IDEs provided a visual and integrated workflow for writing and managing code. In the early days, developers interacting heavily on command-line. Formatting code, navigating files, searching references, and refactoring logic were mostly manual tasks. Over time, IDEs transformed this experience.
